piezas.titulo: Production practice: Education, culture and community
texto: Integrated conversation: talking about customs and cultural diversity. When debating traditional festivals, distinguish descriptive facts from personal judgements. To agree with nuance: «เห็นด้วยครับ แม้ว่ารูปแบบจะเปลี่ยนไป แต่จิตวิญญาณของชุมชนยังคงอยู่» (I agree; although the format changes, the community spirit remains). Practise intercultural respect and oral fluency.
